            // After HTMX swaps mini-cart content (e.g. add-to-cart), open the
            // Bootstrap offcanvas briefly so the user sees the update.
            var miniCartTimeout;
            var miniCartContent = document.getElementById('mini-cart-content');
            var offcanvasEl = document.getElementById('miniCartOffcanvas');
            
            if (miniCartContent && offcanvasEl) {
                miniCartContent.addEventListener('htmx:afterSwap', function(e) {
                    var path = e.detail.requestConfig ? e.detail.requestConfig.path : '';
                    if (path.indexOf('addToCartSlider') !== -1) {
                        var oc = bootstrap.Offcanvas.getOrCreateInstance(offcanvasEl);
                        oc.show();
                        if (miniCartTimeout) clearTimeout(miniCartTimeout);
                        miniCartTimeout = setTimeout(function() { oc.hide(); }, 3000);
                    }
                });
                
                offcanvasEl.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
                    if (miniCartTimeout) clearTimeout(miniCartTimeout);
                });
            }

            // Intercept htmx:confirm to show Bootstrap modal instead of native confirm()
            // Only intercept when hx-confirm is set (detail.question is non-empty)
            document.body.addEventListener('htmx:confirm', function(e) {
                if (!e.detail.question) return;  // no hx-confirm attr → let request proceed
                e.preventDefault();
                var modalEl = document.getElementById('confirmModal');
                var bodyEl = document.getElementById('confirmModalBody');
                var yesBtn = document.getElementById('confirmModalYes');
                bodyEl.textContent = e.detail.question;
                var modal = bootstrap.Modal.getOrCreateInstance(modalEl);
                // Remove any old click handler
                var newYes = yesBtn.cloneNode(true);
                yesBtn.parentNode.replaceChild(newYes, yesBtn);
                newYes.addEventListener('click', function() {
                    modal.hide();
                    e.detail.issueRequest(true);
                });
                modal.show();
            });
        })();
